integrity.finite_checker: Exact small-walk enumeration and moment-recursion checks with numerical finite-horizon illustrations; these do not certify weak convergence.
integrity.proof_basis: Local Bernoulli point-process convergence, convergence of sign integrals, stationary generator moments and exact covariance integration.

scientific_limitations: Valid for fixed c>0 and bounded convergent exponent-window parameter; no rate of convergence or joint unbounded-window theorem.
Earlier work already established the fixed-critical c/k Beta and functional zigzag laws; the assessed claim is the observation-horizon-dependent nonlinear window.
Priority against unknown broader triangular-array process limit theorems is not independently assessed.
title: Nonlinear logarithmic-window Beta crossover for persistent random walks
